_what: A measured read of the `VDS Tokens` variable collection in the Figma file named by FIGMA_FILE_KEY. It is EVIDENCE, not intent: it records what the collection actually holds so a test can pair it against what build.js emits. Never hand-edit a value to make a test pass - that turns the one artefact that can detect drift into a restatement of the code.
_how: Re-derive with the Figma MCP: read getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync(), find the collection by name, then for each variable in it record valuesByMode keyed by MODE NAME (not modeId, which is file-local and changes on duplicate). Colours are written as lowercase #rrggbb; FLOATs as numbers.
_history: The first measurement (2026-07-30) found the collection carrying 13 variables against the packs' 17, and 9 mode values disagreeing with the pack that defines them - the Base palette measurement had landed in tokens/*.json and never reached Figma. The four ink variables were created and the nine values corrected in the same pass; these values are the post-fix read-back, not the request.
